title: Capsule endoscopy
what: You swallow a capsule the size of a large pill. Inside is a camera that takes pictures of your bowel as the capsule passes through it.
why: To look at the small bowel, which a regular gastroscopy and colonoscopy cannot reach. For example, for hidden bleeding or anemia with no clear cause.
duration: swallowing the capsule takes a minute; recording lasts about 8 to 12 hours
tell_doctor: If you had belly surgery, a bowel blockage, or a narrowed bowel
All your medicines, especially iron tablets. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: Usually light food for 24 hours, and liquids during the day. No vegetables with skins, seeds, or berries with seeds.

prepare.title: Cleansing
prepare.text: Often you are given a bowel cleansing solution, like before a colonoscopy. Drink it as your clinic instructs.

prepare.title: Fasting
prepare.text: Usually no food for 10 to 12 hours before the test. Your clinic will give you the exact time.

prepare.title: Clothes
prepare.text: Loose cotton clothes. Sensors will be stuck on your belly, or a belt with a recorder will be put on.

bring: Reports from past gastroscopy and colonoscopy
steps: Sensors are stuck on your belly, or a belt is put on
A small recorder is attached to the belt
You swallow the capsule with water
You can go home or stay at the clinic, depending on the clinic's rules
Clear water is usually allowed after 2 hours, and light food after 4 hours
In the evening, or after 8 to 12 hours, you return the recorder
feel: Swallowing the capsule is like a large pill
You will not feel it inside
after: The capsule leaves on its own with your stool, usually in 1 to 3 days. You do not need to catch it. It is single-use
Until the capsule has passed, you cannot have an MRI
Stay away from strong magnets and radio transmitters while recording
Results usually come in a few days. The doctor looks through thousands of images
red_flags: Severe belly pain, bloating, or vomiting
No gas or stool, especially if the capsule has not passed yet

faq.q: What do I do with the capsule after it comes out?
faq.a: Nothing. It is single-use, and you do not need to catch it. If you are not sure it has passed, tell your doctor.
Rarely. It is more likely if the bowel is narrowed. That is why you should tell the doctor about bowel surgery and bowel disease beforehand.

faq.q: Does the capsule replace a colonoscopy?
faq.a: Usually not. The capsule mostly looks at the small bowel and cannot take a tissue sample.

reminders.text: Capsule endoscopy tomorrow. Light food today. Prepare as your clinic instructed.
From now on, you usually do not eat until the test. Check the time in your clinic's instructions.
